title: The #1 Resume SECRET Recruiters Look For (That Wins Interviews)
description:
Most resumes don’t get skipped because candidates aren’t qualified. They get skipped because recruiters can’t quickly see how the candidate solves the problem the role was designed to solve.

In this video, I break down the #1 resume secret recruiters look for and how positioning yourself as the solution, not just listing tasks or achievements, helps you win interviews.

This approach shows employers you’ve solved this problem before and can solve it again for them.

I’m Kate Kirchner, career strategist with nearly 20 years of experience helping job seekers get seen by recruiters.

 Watch the Get Seen series for more strategies on writing a winning resume that gets interviews @kirchnercareers
